name: Aeon, Zenith, Magical
body:
AEON, ZENITH, MAGICAL
CR 30/MR 10

XP 9,830,400
N Fine outsider (extraplanar, incorporeal, mythic, swarm)
Init +25/+5M, dual initiative MA; Senses darkvision 60 ft., greater arcane sight, touchsight 100 ft., true seeing; Perception +46; Aura harmony 300 ft. (DC 37)

DEFENSE

AC 42, touch 42, flat-footed 31 (+13 deflection, +11 Dex, +8 size)
hp 735 (31d10+565); regeneration 30 (deific or Mythic)
Fort +25, Ref +21, Will +27
DR 10/epic; Immune cold, critical hits, incorporeal traits, poison, spells, swarm traits; Resist acid 30, electricity 30, fire 30, sonic 30; SR 41

OFFENSE

Speed fly 200 ft. (perfect)
Melee Swarm (20d6 force damage plus subsume)
Space 60 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks archmage abilities, lore of a million worlds, mythic power (unlimited, surge +1d12), subsume
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 25th; concentration +38)

Constant—freedom of movement, greater arcane sight, true seeing
At will—discern location M, greater dispel magic, locate prodigy, shared lore
3/day—ascensionM, wishM

Wizard Spells Prepared (CL 25th; DC 25 + spell level; concentration +40)

9th (5/day)—gate M, mage’s disjunction, mass heal
8th (5/day)—polymorph any object, sympathy, temporal stasis
7th (6/day)—control weather M, limited wish M, project image
6th (6/day)—antimagic field M, legend lore, geas/quest
5th (7/day)—greater forbid action, mirage arcana, telekinesis M, true seeing
4th (7/day)—blessing of fervorM, dimension door M, dimensional anchor, greater path of glory
3rd (8/day)—haste M, prayer M, slow, wind wall
2nd (9/day)—mirror image, pyrotechnics, shield other M, silence M, surmount affliction M
1st (9/day)—divine favor, floating disk, moment of greatness, sanctuary, unseen servant 0 (at will)—arcane mark, create water, detect magic, ghost sound, mage hand, mending, prestidigitation, purify food and drink, read magic

STATISTICS

Str —, Dex 33, Con 41, Int 40, Wis 35, Cha 36
Base Atk +31; CMB +23; CMD 56
Feats Detect ExpertiseM, Dazing Spell, Empower Spell, Extend Spell, Flyby Attack, Greater Spell Penetration, Heighten Spell, Improved Initiative M, Maximize Spell, Mythic Paragon M, Mythic Spell Lore M, Persistent Spell, Quicken Spell, Reach Spell, Spell Penetration M, Spell Perfection (limited wish), Spontaneous Metafocus, Widen Spell
Skills Appraise +46, Craft (any one) +49, Diplomacy +47, Intimidate +47, Knowledge (all) +63, Heal +43, Perception +46, Sense Motive +46, Spellcraft +49, Stealth +53, Survival +43, Use Magic Device +44
Languages envisaging
SQ extension of all, greater starflight

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Archmage Abilities (Su)

A zenith possesses the Wild Arcana ability of an Archmage, as well as the following Archmage Path Abilities: Eldritch Breach, Flash of Omniscience, Rapid Preparation, Arcane Metamastery x4, Channel Power, Deep Understanding, Competent Caster, and Crafting Mastery.

Aura of Harmony (Su)

Any creature within 300 ft. of a zenith is put at ease by the vastness and scintillating glory of the entity. All creatures must succeed at a DC 37 Will save or become fascinated so long as they remain within the aura. For every 10 rounds that the creature spends inside this aura, its alignment moves one step closer to true neutral (this is considered a willing change). If a true neutral creature remains fascinated for more than 5 rounds, the zenith may deal its swarm damage to the target as a free action (which does not interfere with the fascination effect). The save DC is Charisma-based.

Greater Starflight (Ex)

A zenith flies through outer space at incredible speeds. Although the exact travel time will vary from one trip to the next, a trip within a solar system normally takes a zenith 2d6 hours, and a trip beyond normally takes 2d6 days (or more, at the GM’s discretion).

Lore of a Million Worlds (Su)

A zenith possesses knowledge of every spell ever created on any spell list.

It can prepare these spells as a 20th-level arcanist, save that it requires no spellbook. A zenith can also exchange its feats and skills every time it prepares spells. A zenith requires no components of any kind for casting spells. In addition, a zenith is treated as having unlimited uses of mythic power per day. In addition, the zenith may target itself with spells as if it did not possess the swarm subtype.

Subsume (Su)

Any intelligent creature reduced to 0 hit points by the zenith’s swarm attack must succeed at a DC 39 WIll save or be subsumed into the zenith, entering into the shared consciousness of millions of transcendent entities. Creatures destroyed in this way can be restored to life only through miracle, true resurrection, wish, or divine intervention. The save DC is Constitution-based.
